text_block_list.text:
One day, at Gold City's request, we were 
training hard until the very last rays of 
the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...!
(Flump flump flump!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Just now, I thought...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino? What're you doing?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, hyah, ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, calm down.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, there are a crazy amount of 
plastic bottles scattered at our feet, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, this is some delicious water from 
Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of bringing City-san some 
refreshments, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san looked so incredibly gorgeous 
bathed in the sunset... I was completely 
captivated...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Pretty, huh. In the end, that's really 
all it comes down to."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hohe?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, sure. Just couldn't shake that 
"pretty" label, could I?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to hear people call me a 
'strong' Umamusume, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't really care anymore. I just 
run because I want to run—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You don't get it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san is insanely pretty on the 
outside. She really, truly is gorgeous. 
But that's not all there is to her!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Pretty" encompasses everything! Being 
strong, being amazing, all of it!
"You look so beautiful right now."
"You look truly beautiful right now."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If City-san felt that people only ever 
judged her by her looks, then that 
honestly breaks my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because City-san really is so beautiful in 
every single way...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Back then, too—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You looked so gorgeous when you were 
running! City, you're the best~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, even though you're a model, 
you're amazing! You're so cool, City!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You mean... there were people watching me 
while I ran...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Miss City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What's that about? You just jumped to 
conclusions on your own? Lame. You've got 
zero chill.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're so stupid it's 
hilarious... Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ... It's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh—?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You've always, always been gorgeous, 
but... You're truly stunning right now, 
City-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I love it. The City-san of right now is 
the absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know. Because right now— I actually love 
the person I am, too!
